effective.basis: Old state: UDE official card rulings (Sangan/Witch: 'If you have no eligible monsters, your opponent gets to see your Deck to verify', captured 2005-06-16) through Konami's own per-set rulings documents - Machina Mayhem (2010-04-06, 18 days before the Edison snapshot), Starstrike Blast (2010-11-16), Storm of Ragnarok (2011-02-02). New state: KDE-US Tournament Policy section 'Card/Hand/Deck Verification' forbids verifying the opponent's Deck (first located capture 2019-04-03; still current in v2.5, 2025-09-05). No dated announcement of the change was found, so the interval 2011-02-02 .. 2019-04-03 stays open.

changes.historical_text: When this card is Normal Summoned or Flip Summoned, you can select 1 Ritual Monster Card from your Deck and add it to your hand. Then shuffle your Deck.
changes.summary: Period procedure plus a relaxed activation condition, not a text erratum: the GOAT script reduces s.tg to `if chk==0 then return true end` (the modern Duel.IsExistingMatchingCard over LOCATION_DECK is removed), so the Normal/Flip Summon trigger can be used with no Ritual Monster left in the Deck, and the failed search is proven by revealing the Deck (Duel.GoatConfirm(tp,LOCATION_DECK)); the modern script requires a Ritual Monster in the Deck and never reveals. The only other diff, the Ritual-Monster filter written as the raw type mask (c:GetType()&0x81)==0x81 instead of c:IsRitualMonster(), is the same test.

review.notes: Chain starts at v1 (DB1-EN046, 2004-10-12), the text the GOAT variant carries exactly. v0 (MRL-080, 2002, 'summoned to the field (excluding Special Summon)') predates the baseline and states the same trigger; v1->v2 (RP01-EN068) and v2->v3 (AP07-EN016, PSCT colon) drop the shuffle wording and 'Monster Card', both cosmetic. Flagged chronology-unresolved because the script encodes both components of the era package and only the reveal is dated: this card has no entry in the 2005-06-16 UDE Card Rulings capture or the 2008-12-15 Konami Card FAQ capture, so the end date of its relaxed activation condition is unattested, and four cards in this batch demonstrably lost that allowance by 2008-12-15. GOAT-era applicability of the package is not in doubt; Edison-era applicability of the activation component is not independently confirmed.
